buildCommand: python3 scripts/contributions-alignment-driver-v11.py >/tmp/contributions-driver.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/contributions-driver.log; exit 1; }; { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRTUXB; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -v '^public/contributions-qualified-' | grep -v '^scripts/' | grep -v '^vercel.json$' | sort -u > /tmp/contributions-mail-files.txt; echo transfer_files=$(wc -l < /tmp/contributions-mail-files.txt); tar -czf /tmp/contributions-qualified-product.tar.gz -T /tmp/contributions-mail-files.txt; sha256sum /tmp/contributions-qualified-product.tar.gz; node scripts/email-qualified-contributions.js; false
